name: Protected-access manual-operation qualifier
summary: This qualifier indicates that manual access to the operating mechanism is protected or restricted.
description: This qualifier indicates that manual access to the operating mechanism is protected or restricted. An operating mechanism may sit behind a cover or another access restriction. The qualifier draws attention to that access condition without describing the construction of the cover, lock or enclosure.
A circuit drawing can record the access-qualified operation while a GA or equipment document shows the actual opening and hardware. Do not infer a particular key sequence from this qualifier.
readingNotes: Record the actual access arrangement separately from the contact logic.
A protected-access indication does not specify a keyed lock, enclosure rating or permission system by itself.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Record the actual access arrangement separately from the contact logic.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: A protected-access indication does not specify a keyed lock, enclosure rating or permission system by itself.
